CANNOT_BE_ACCEPTED_IN_STATUS: The service cannot be accepted in this status
CANNOT_BE_COMPLETED_IN_STATUS: The service cannot be completed in this status
CANNOT_BE_STARTED_IN_STATUS: The service cannot be started in this status
CANNOT_CANCEL_IN_STATUS: A service in this status cannot be cancelled
CANNOT_UPDATE_IN_STATUS: A service in this status cannot be modified

NOTIFICATION_CANCELLED_BY_CLIENT_MESSAGE: The client cancelled the service you were assigned to.
NOTIFICATION_CANCELLED_BY_PROFESSIONAL_M: The professional cancelled the service you had in progress.
NO_LONGER_ACCEPTING_REQUESTS: The service is no longer available to accept requests
NO_LONGER_PENDING: The service is no longer pending — someone else accepted it first

ONLY_ASSIGNED_PROFESSIONAL_CAN_START: Only the assigned professional can start the service
ONLY_CLIENT_CAN_ANSWER_REQUESTS: Only the client can answer the requests
ONLY_PENDING_ACCEPT_REQUESTS: Requests can only be created for pending services
PROGRESS_LOG_REQUIRED: This category requires at least one progress log entry before the service can be completed
REQUEST_ALREADY_SENT: You have already sent a request for this service
STATUS_CHANGED_BEFORE_CANCEL: The service changed status before it could be cancelled
STATUS_CHANGED_BEFORE_COMPLETE: The service changed status before it could be completed
STATUS_CHANGED_BEFORE_START: The service changed status before it could be started
STATUS_CHANGED_BEFORE_UPDATE: The service changed status before it could be updated

UNAUTHORIZED_UPDATE: You do not have permission to modify this service
